name: National Cybercrime Helpline 1930
when_to_use: Use first if money already left your account. Call within the golden hour.
what_it_does: Helps report an online financial fraud so banks can try to freeze the amount.

name: National Cybercrime Reporting Portal
when_to_use: After calling 1930, file a written complaint with screenshots and UPI references.
what_it_does: Takes a cyber fraud complaint and gives an acknowledgement number.

name: DoT Chakshu
situation: I got a suspicious call or SMS
when_to_use: When a phone number, SMS or WhatsApp message looks like a scam.
what_it_does: Lets you report suspected fraud communications to the Department of Telecommunications.

name: Sanchar Saathi
when_to_use: If the handset is lost or stolen, or you see an unknown SIM in your name.
what_it_does: Block a lost phone, check SIMs issued with your ID, and report fraud connections.

name: CEIR
when_to_use: Right after a phone is lost, with the IMEI number from the box or bill.
what_it_does: Blocks the IMEI on Indian networks so the phone is harder to reuse.

name: UIDAI Aadhaar services
when_to_use: If someone asks for OTP, biometrics, or lock/unlock of Aadhaar.
what_it_does: Lock biometrics, check usage history, and update contact details on the official site only.

name: RBI Sachet
when_to_use: Before putting money into a scheme that promises unusually high returns.
what_it_does: Lists unauthorised collection schemes and where to complain.

name: PIB Fact Check
when_to_use: When a post claims a new government benefit, laptop, or cash transfer.
what_it_does: Official fact checks of viral government claims.

name: myScheme
when_to_use: To confirm whether a government scheme actually exists.
